oliver: Opening a small PR to clarify embed vs generate examples for the nebula family. Found users hitting errors when using non-embed model for embeddings. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3110

maya: thanks. Can we include both curl and python snippets? A one-line callout that embed models end with '-embed' would help.

tara: also add a short 'known quirk' note: nebula3b-quant-embed returns slightly different vector lengths when client tokenizes differently. Bench investigating.

bench-team: confirmed. quantization changes token boundaries ~8% for some sequences. We'll attach a minimal repro and token-count jq command.

docs-bot: PR opened by oliver in redwood-inference/docs (#3110) — labels: docs, needs-review

maya: I'll add a tiny migration blurb and a compatibility row: streaming: no (quant), embeddings: yes, long-context: limited. Use relative links to /model-catalog/nebula3b.

tara: added the curl + python v3 snippet and a quick token-count helper. PTAL.

maya: lgtm after bench artifact is linked. Good to standardize wording across nebula cards.

oliver: thanks all — moving to merge once bench artifact is in PR.
